end.text: The Greek root word hydr means water.
end.sound: The Greek root word hydruh means water.

atoms.a: What could the prefix de- mean in dehydration?
atoms.sound: What could the prefix, dee, mean in dehydration?

end.text: If you combine de- and hydrate, you get the word dehydrate. This verb means that water is removed from somewhere.
end.sound: If you combine dee-. and .hydrate, you get the word dehydrate. This verb means that water is removed from somewhere.

hint.text: Other words with the prefix de- : decline, delete, depart

atoms.a: If dehydrate means the removal of water, what could the suffix -ion in dehydration mean?
atoms.sound: If dehydrate means the removal of water, what could the suffix, ion, in dehydration mean?

end.text: Adding the suffix -ion to the word, dehydrate, transforms the word from a verb to a noun. Together, dehydration means the process of dehydrating, or losing water.
end.sound: Adding the <t-pink>suffix</t-pink> , ion, to the word, dehydrate, transforms the word from a verb to a noun. Together, dehydration means the process of dehydrating, or losing water.

hint.text: Other words with the suffix -ion: organisation, direction, competition
